snippet.title: Mourningwood Lodge | Gameplay PC
snippet.description:
《Mourningwood Lodge》 is a full-motion video (FMV) live-action mystery horror game. As the first installment in the Funeral Houseseries, players will assume different roles across various game modes to participate in a suspenseful horror journey blending conspiracy and fantasy.

In the initially released ​​Story Mode​​, players take on the role of an heir to the ancient sect ​​"Fangxian Dao"​​ tasked with thwarting an evil ritual. After becoming entangled in a series of premeditated events, they are implicated in a murder and must collaborate with others to escape. Throughout the process, ​​player choices will determine radically different game endings​​.

Story Background
The story takes place in an eerie villa deep within the mountains. When was it built? By whom? And for what purpose? No one knows. What is certain is that this villa is far more than it appears, for those who know of its existence have all...

Game Features
​​Search​​
Every character the player encounters in the game holds many secrets. Search the corresponding characters to obtain clues. Some clues are hidden in unseen places. Only by finding them can more endings be unlocked.

​​Deduction​​
Through the protagonist Fang Xiandao's "divination" magic, players can glimpse into the past experiences of different characters. Piece together and reconstruct the truth of the story with limited information, ultimately achieving the goal.

​​Details​​
The game is filled with various hidden clues. Discovering them will help players obtain information more quickly and completely, advancing the game.

​​Perspective Review​​
After completing the first playthrough, players can review the story and objectives from the perspectives of different characters. Gain a more diverse and unique experience.
